Title: February 19, 2026 Regular City Council Meeting (Boulder City Council)
Overview: The February 19, 2026 Boulder City Council regular meeting opened with public comment on the future of the South Boulder Rec Center pool and gym, where many residents and swim team members urged the council to keep the facilities, though staff said no decisions have been made and rec center discussions are planned for spring study sessions. The council also approved consent agenda items 3A and 3B, adopted Resolution 1370, Ordinance 8734, and a Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan land use change to annex about 24 acres at 5399 Kowani Drive and 5697 South Boulder Road, and gave non-binding feedback on a concept to redevelop the Pearl Street storage site with about 281 apartments. Other public comments covered topics such as trail safety, property taxes, and climate resilience, and staff committed to follow up on several of them.

Topic1.Title: Roll Call and Open Comment Procedures
Topic1.Summary: Council convened the regular meeting with roll call confirming a quorum. The clerk reviewed public participation guidelines and rules of decorum for open comment.

Topic2.Title: Open Comment on South Boulder Rec Center Pool
Topic2.Summary: Many residents, students, and Fairview swim team members urged council to keep the South Boulder Rec Center pool and gym, citing proximity for families, seniors, and youth. Speakers questioned the 2025 engineering report and parks department priorities. Staff said no decisions have been made and that more discussions on rec centers are planned for spring study sessions.

Topic3.Title: Open Comment on Other Community Issues
Topic3.Summary: Speakers raised concerns including Middle East policy, dog off-leash trail safety and the Voice and Sight tag program, ambulance sedation allegations against a former provider, property taxes, and climate resilience and microgrids. Council members thanked speakers and staff committed to follow-up on several items.

Topic4.Title: Consent Agenda
Topic4.Summary: Council approved consent agenda items 3A and 3B by unanimous roll call vote.

Topic5.Title: Hogan-Pancost Property Annexation and Land Use Change
Topic5.Summary: Council held a public hearing on annexing about 24 acres at 5399 Kowani Drive and 5697 South Boulder Road, including part of 55th Street, with public zoning and RL-2 for right-of-way. Parks and Recreation proposed flood mitigation and parks use west of 55th, with open space east of 55th. Council adopted Resolution 1370, Ordinance 8734, and the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan land use map change unanimously. Public comment included a botanic garden proposal.

Topic6.Title: Pearl Street Storage Site Concept Review
Topic6.Summary: Council gave feedback on a concept review for redeveloping the Boulder Storage site at 4880 and 4898 Pearl Street with about 281 apartments and a new storage building in a General Industrial zone. Key issues were consistency with the BVCP, the East Boulder subcommunity plan, and the six-percent contiguity rule for residential use. Council members generally wanted to preserve industrial character and asked the applicant to rethink the design and mix of uses. No formal action was taken.
